_meta._note: Scaffold copy drafted in T3 for the PDPA consent banner. Live site has no equivalent banner today; all strings here are drafted (see _draft map) and to be refined in T12. 2026-08-09: banner.heading/body and all three optional toggle descriptions rewritten to close HANDOVER G3 (banner implied control it did not have; the analytics toggle gates only a browser-local demo store). personalization + chatbot descriptions widened to cover reuse-for-enquiry, matching CONSENT_VERSION 1 → 2.

banner.heading: What this site saves on your device
banner.body: These choices only affect what we store in your own browser. Nothing here is sent to a server or shared with an advertising network, and you can change or clear it at any time.

necessary.label: Necessary
necessary.description: Required for the site to work — your language choice, text size, and these consent settings.

analytics.label: Analytics
analytics.description: Counts of pages viewed and buttons clicked, kept in your own browser for the on-site analytics demo. Nothing is sent to us or to any analytics provider.

personalization.label: Personalization
personalization.description: Your answers to the 'tell us about your child' prompt. We use them to reorder what this site shows you, and to fill in your enquiry form if you contact us. This includes sensitive personal data; explicit consent only.

chatbot.label: Chat history
chatbot.description: Keeps your chat transcripts between visits, and lets what you told the assistant — your name, phone number and the service you asked about — carry over into the enquiry form. Off = this visit only.
